description: This source file contains extension methods for configuring Redis-based clustering in Orleans. It adds methods to set up Redis clustering, including configuring services such as RedisMembershipTable and validation components, by extending ISiloBuilder and IServiceCollection.

classes.name: RedisClusteringISiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder and IServiceCollection to setup Redis clustering.

methods.name: UseRedisClustering
methods.description: An extension method that configures Redis as the clustering provider using a configuration action.

methods.name: UseRedisClustering
methods.description: An overload that configures Redis clustering using a connection string.

methods.name: AddRedisClustering
methods.description: An internal method that registers Redis clustering services, such as RedisMembershipTable and validation services.
